position.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_employees.position. Nullable string for job title. Optional field that can be set later if not known at invitation time.

employment_type.description: Employment type classification. Can be set later if not known at invitation time.
employment_type.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_employees.employment_type. Enum value: full-time, part-time, contractor, or intern. Nullable - can be set later if not known at invitation time. Validate against allowed values if provided.

IHrmPlatformEmployee.IInvite.description: Request body for inviting a new employee to the organization. The email address determines whether an existing member is added to the organization or a pending invitation is created for a new user. Role assignment is required; department, position, and employment type are optional and can be configured later.
IHrmPlatformEmployee.IInvite.x-autobe-specification: Request DTO for employee invitation. Email maps to hrm_platform_members lookup (not a direct DB column). role_id, department_id, position, employment_type map directly to hrm_platform_employees columns. member_id resolved from email lookup. organization_id from JWT context. status defaults to 'active'. System fields (id, timestamps, deleted_at) auto-generated. Validates role_id exists in hrm_platform_roles for current organization, department_id exists in hrm_platform_departments if provided, employment_type is one of: full-time, part-time, contractor, intern.

action_type.description: Filter by the type of action performed. Examples: employee.invited, employee.deactivated, contract.created, project.archived, task.status_changed, timesheet.submitted.
action_type.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping to hrm_platform_activity_logs.action_type column. Exact match filter for action types like employee.invited, project.created, timesheet.approved, etc.

member_id.description: Filter by the member who performed the action. UUID format referencing hrm_platform_members.id.
member_id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping to hrm_platform_activity_logs.member_id column. UUID format filter to find actions performed by a specific member.

target_entity_type.description: Filter by the type of entity that was acted upon. Examples: employee, contract, project, task, timesheet, role, department.
target_entity_type.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping to hrm_platform_activity_logs.target_entity_type column. Exact match filter for entity types like employee, project, task, timesheet, role, department.

target_entity_id.description: Filter by the UUID of the target entity that was acted upon. References the ID of the entity specified in target_entity_type.
target_entity_id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping to hrm_platform_activity_logs.target_entity_id column. UUID format filter to find actions on a specific entity instance.

created_at_from.description: Filter activity logs created on or after this timestamp. ISO 8601 date-time format (e.g., 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z).
created_at_from.x-autobe-specification: Computed filter parameter. Translates to SQL: created_at >= created_at_from. ISO 8601 date-time format. Used to filter activity logs from a specific start date.

created_at_to.description: Filter activity logs created on or before this timestamp. ISO 8601 date-time format (e.g., 2024-12-31T23:59:59Z).
created_at_to.x-autobe-specification: Computed filter parameter. Translates to SQL: created_at <= created_at_to. ISO 8601 date-time format. Used to filter activity logs up to a specific end date.

page.description: Page number for pagination (1-indexed). Defaults to 1 if not provided. Used to navigate through paginated results.
page.x-autobe-specification: Computed pagination parameter. 1-indexed page number for offset pagination. Translates to SQL OFFSET: (page - 1) * limit. Minimum value is 1.

limit.description: Number of items per page. Minimum 1, maximum 100. Controls how many activity log entries are returned per page.
limit.x-autobe-specification: Computed pagination parameter. Number of items per page. Minimum 1, maximum 100. Translates to SQL LIMIT clause. Controls page size for paginated responses.

IHrmPlatformActivityLog.IRequest.description: Search criteria and pagination parameters for filtering activity log entries. Supports filtering by action type, member who performed the action, target entity type and ID, and creation date range. All parameters are optional to allow flexible querying. Results are automatically scoped to the user's current organization context.
IHrmPlatformActivityLog.IRequest.x-autobe-specification: Request body for filtering and paginating activity log queries. Maps filter fields to hrm_platform_activity_logs columns: action_type (exact match), member_id (UUID match), target_entity_type (exact match), target_entity_id (UUID match), created_at_from/to (range filter on created_at). Pagination fields page and limit control offset pagination. Organization context is automatically applied from user session (organization_id filter), not exposed in request body.

totalHours.description: Total hours logged across all timelogs in the project, calculated by dividing total minutes by 60. Represents the aggregate time investment in the project.
totalHours.x-autobe-specification: Computed as SUM(duration_minutes) / 60.0 from hrm_platform_timelogs filtered by project_id and request body filters. Returns floating-point number representing total hours with decimal precision.

totalMinutes.description: Total minutes logged across all timelogs in the project. This is the raw aggregation of duration_minutes before conversion to hours.
totalMinutes.x-autobe-specification: Computed as SUM(duration_minutes) from hrm_platform_timelogs filtered by project_id and request body filters. Returns integer representing the raw sum of all duration_minutes values.

employeeBreakdown.description: Time breakdown grouped by employee, showing how much time each team member contributed to the project. Each entry includes employee identification and their total logged time.
employeeBreakdown.x-autobe-specification: Computed by GROUP BY employee_id on hrm_platform_timelogs, then JOIN hrm_platform_employees to include employee name and avatar_url. Each breakdown item contains employee_id, name, avatar_url, totalMinutes, and totalHours. Returns empty array if no timelogs match filters.

taskBreakdown.description: Time breakdown grouped by task, showing how time was distributed across different work items in the project. Each entry includes task identification and total time spent.
taskBreakdown.x-autobe-specification: Computed by GROUP BY task_id on hrm_platform_timelogs, then JOIN hrm_platform_tasks to include task title. Each breakdown item contains task_id, title, totalMinutes, and totalHours. Timelogs with NULL task_id are grouped separately. Returns empty array if no timelogs match filters.

dailyBreakdown.description: Time breakdown grouped by date, showing daily time logging patterns. Each entry represents one day's total logged time in the project.
dailyBreakdown.x-autobe-specification: Computed by GROUP BY DATE(date) on hrm_platform_timelogs. Each breakdown item contains date (YYYY-MM-DD format), totalMinutes, and totalHours. Ordered chronologically. Returns empty array if no timelogs match filters.

billableBreakdown.description: Time split between billable and non-billable hours. Shows the distribution of chargeable versus non-chargeable work time in the project.
billableBreakdown.x-autobe-specification: Computed by GROUP BY billable on hrm_platform_timelogs. Returns object with two properties: billableMinutes (SUM where billable=true), nonBillableMinutes (SUM where billable=false), plus derived billableHours and nonBillableHours. Both values default to 0 if no matching timelogs.

dateRange.description: Date range covered by the analytics, showing the earliest and latest timelog dates in the filtered result set. Helps identify the time period represented in the analytics.
dateRange.x-autobe-specification: Computed as MIN(date) and MAX(date) from hrm_platform_timelogs filtered by project_id and request body filters. Returns object with fromDate (earliest timelog date) and toDate (latest timelog date) in YYYY-MM-DD format. Both values are null if no timelogs match filters.

IHrmPlatformProjectTimeAnalytic.description: Aggregated time tracking analytics for a specific project. Provides comprehensive time statistics including total hours and minutes logged, breakdowns by employee, task, and date, billable versus non-billable time distribution, and the date range covered by the analytics. Used for project time analysis, budget tracking, and reporting dashboards. Data is computed on-demand from timelog records filtered by project and optional query parameters.
IHrmPlatformProjectTimeAnalytic.x-autobe-specification: Computed analytics DTO aggregating hrm_platform_timelogs filtered by project_id. Query: SELECT SUM(duration_minutes) as totalMinutes, SUM(duration_minutes)/60.0 as totalHours, GROUP BY employee_id for employeeBreakdown (JOIN hrm_platform_employees for name, avatar_url), GROUP BY task_id for taskBreakdown (JOIN hrm_platform_tasks for title), GROUP BY DATE(date) for dailyBreakdown, GROUP BY billable for billableBreakdown, MIN(date) and MAX(date) for dateRange. Apply request filters: date BETWEEN fromDate AND toDate, employee_id IN employeeIds, task_id IN taskIds, billable = filter value. Edge case: no matching timelogs returns totalHours=0, totalMinutes=0, empty arrays for breakdowns, dateRange with null values.

hoursToday.description: Total hours logged today by the employee in decimal format (e.g., 7.5 for 7 hours 30 minutes). Calculated from all timelog entries for the current date in Asia/Seoul timezone.
hoursToday.x-autobe-specification: Computed from hrm_platform_timelogs: SUM(duration_minutes) WHERE employee_id = current user's employee record AND DATE(date AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') = current date. Result divided by 60 to convert minutes to decimal hours. Excludes timelogs from deleted/archived projects. Returns 0 if no timelogs exist for today.

hoursThisWeek.description: Total hours logged this week (Monday through Sunday) by the employee in decimal format. Calculated from all timelog entries within the current week period in Asia/Seoul timezone.
hoursThisWeek.x-autobe-specification: Computed from hrm_platform_timelogs: SUM(duration_minutes) WHERE employee_id = current user's employee record AND date BETWEEN current week's Monday 00:00 and Sunday 23:59 (Asia/Seoul timezone). Result divided by 60 to convert minutes to decimal hours. Excludes timelogs from deleted/archived projects. Returns 0 if no timelogs exist for this week.

activeTimer.description: Currently running timer session if one exists, null when no timer is active. Includes project reference, optional task reference, start timestamp, and work description.
activeTimer.x-autobe-specification: Query hrm_platform_timers WHERE employee_id = current user's employee record AND stopped_at IS NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL. If found, return timer with project (JOIN hrm_platform_projects returning ISummary), task (LEFT JOIN hrm_platform_tasks returning ISummary or null), started_at, description. Returns null if no active timer exists. Each employee can have at most one active timer at a time.

recentTimelogs.description: Five most recent time entries with project and task context, ordered by date descending. Each entry includes work date, duration, billable status, and optional description with project and task references.
recentTimelogs.x-autobe-specification: Query hrm_platform_timelogs WHERE employee_id = current user's employee record AND deleted_at IS NULL, ORDER BY date DESC, created_at DESC, LIMIT 5 (or timelogsLimit from request body). Each timelog includes employee (ISummary), project (ISummary via JOIN), task (ISummary via LEFT JOIN or null), date, duration_minutes, billable, description. Returns empty array if no timelogs exist.

pendingTimesheet.description: Current week's timesheet status if exists, null when no timesheet has been created for this week. Includes week period dates, workflow status, total hours, and rejection reason if rejected.
pendingTimesheet.x-autobe-specification: Query hrm_platform_timesheets WHERE employee_id = current user's employee record AND week_start_date = current week's Monday (Asia/Seoul) AND deleted_at IS NULL. Return timesheet with status (draft/submitted/approved/rejected), total_hours (computed from SUM of contained timelogs' duration_minutes / 60), submitted_at, reviewed_at, rejection_reason (if status = 'rejected'), employee (ISummary). Returns null if no timesheet exists for current week.

assignedTasks.description: All open and in-progress tasks assigned to the employee, sorted by due date and priority. Each task includes title, status, priority, estimated hours, due date, and references to assignee and parent task.
assignedTasks.x-autobe-specification: Query hrm_platform_tasks WHERE hrm_platform_employee_id = current user's employee record AND status IN ('open', 'in-progress') AND deleted_at IS NULL, ORDER BY due_date ASC NULLS LAST, priority DESC. Each task includes id, title, status, priority, estimated_hours, due_date, assignee (ISummary), parent (ISummary or null), created_at. Returns empty array if no tasks match criteria.

IHrmPlatformDashboard.description: Personal dashboard response containing aggregated time tracking statistics and work overview for the authenticated employee. Provides real-time insights into logged hours (today and this week), active timer sessions, recent time entries, pending timesheet approval status, and assigned tasks requiring attention. All metrics are computed from multiple database tables and calculated based on the employee's organization context with Asia/Seoul timezone. Used by employees to monitor their daily work progress and manage time tracking activities.
IHrmPlatformDashboard.x-autobe-specification:
Aggregated dashboard compiled from multiple tables for the authenticated employee:

1. hoursToday: SUM(duration_minutes) from hrm_platform_timelogs WHERE employee_id matches current user AND DATE(date AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') = current date. Convert to decimal hours (divide by 60). Exclude timelogs from deleted/archived projects.

2. hoursThisWeek: SUM(duration_minutes) from hrm_platform_timelogs WHERE employee_id matches AND date BETWEEN current week's Monday 00:00 and Sunday 23:59 (Asia/Seoul timezone). Convert to decimal hours. Exclude deleted/archived projects.

3. activeTimer: SELECT from hrm_platform_timers WHERE employee_id matches AND stopped_at IS NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL. Include project (JOIN hrm_platform_projects), task (LEFT JOIN hrm_platform_tasks), started_at, description. Return null if no active timer exists.

4. recentTimelogs: SELECT from hrm_platform_timelogs WHERE employee_id matches AND deleted_at IS NULL, ORDER BY date DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT 5 (or timelogsLimit from request). Include project name, task title (if exists), duration_minutes, date, billable flag via ISummary DTOs.

5. pendingTimesheet: SELECT from hrm_platform_timesheets WHERE employee_id matches AND week_start_date = current week's Monday (Asia/Seoul) AND deleted_at IS NULL. Return status, total_hours (computed from SUM of timelogs), rejection_reason if status = 'rejected'. Return null if no timesheet exists for current week.

6. assignedTasks: SELECT from hrm_platform_tasks WHERE hrm_platform_employee_id matches current employee AND status IN ('open', 'in-progress') AND deleted_at IS NULL, ORDER BY due_date ASC NULLS LAST, priority DESC. Include title, project (JOIN hrm_platform_projects), priority, due_date, status via ISummary DTOs.

All queries must filter by organization context derived from employee record. Employee record is resolved from JWT session (member_id → employee lookup in current organization).

date.description: Date when the work was performed. This is the work date, not the record creation timestamp. Format: ISO 8601 date-time (e.g., 2024-01-15T09:00:00Z).
date.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_timelogs.date. Must be valid ISO 8601 date-time format representing the date when work was performed (not the creation timestamp).

duration_minutes.description: Duration of work in minutes. Must be a positive integer (minimum 1 minute). For example, 90 minutes for 1.5 hours of work.
duration_minutes.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_timelogs.duration_minutes. Must be a positive integer greater than 0. Represents work duration in minutes.

project_id.description: The project the work was performed on. Must be a project that the employee is assigned to. Format: UUID string.
project_id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_timelogs.project_id. Must be a valid UUID referencing an existing project in hrm_platform_projects. Employee must be assigned to this project (verified via hrm_platform_project_members).

task_id.description: Optional specific task within the project. Set to null to remove task association. If provided, the task must belong to the selected project. Format: UUID string or null.
task_id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_timelogs.task_id. Nullable - can be null to remove task association. If provided, must be a valid UUID referencing a task in hrm_platform_tasks that belongs to the selected project.

description.description: Optional description of what work was performed. Can be set to null to clear the description. Useful for providing context about the specific tasks completed.
description.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_timelogs.description. Nullable string - can be null to clear the description. Optional field for describing what work was performed.

billable.description: Whether this time entry is billable to the client. Set to true for client-billable work, false for internal or non-billable activities.
billable.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_timelogs.billable. Boolean value indicating whether this time entry is billable to the client. Defaults to true if not specified.

IHrmPlatformTimelog.IUpdate.description: Request body for updating an existing timelog record. Allows modification of work date, duration, project/task assignment, description, and billable status. All fields are optional to support partial updates - only provided fields will be modified. The timelog cannot be part of an approved timesheet; update requests for locked timelogs will be rejected with 403 Forbidden.
IHrmPlatformTimelog.IUpdate.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_timelogs table for Update DTO. All 6 fields (date, duration_minutes, project_id, task_id, description, billable) are optional to support partial updates via PUT. Validation: date must be ISO 8601 date-time, duration_minutes must be positive integer (minimum 1), project_id must be valid UUID referencing existing project where employee is assigned, task_id if provided must be valid UUID referencing task belonging to selected project (nullable to clear association), description is nullable string, billable is boolean. Excluded fields: id (immutable PK), created_at/updated_at/deleted_at (system-managed timestamps), employee_id (resolved from JWT actor context), timesheet_id (managed through separate timesheet operations). Relations excluded: employee/project/task/timesheet are belongs-to relations exposed as object references in Read DTOs, not in Update DTOs where scalar FKs are used.

projectId.description: Target project's unique identifier in UUID format.
projectId.x-autobe-specification: Reference to the target project's unique identifier from the API path parameter. Used to filter projects and timelogs queries. Not stored in this computed type's source tables directly.

budgetHours.description: Budget hours allocated to the project. Null when no budget constraint is defined.
budgetHours.x-autobe-specification: Read from hrm_platform_projects.budget_hours column for the target project. Represents the allocated budget hours for the project. Can be null when no budget constraint is defined.

actualHours.description: Total hours logged by employees through timelogs for this project.
actualHours.x-autobe-specification: Computed by aggregating hrm_platform_timelogs.duration_minutes for all timelogs where project_id matches the target project. Sum duration_minutes and divide by 60 to convert minutes to hours. Exclude soft-deleted timelogs from aggregation.

consumptionPercentage.description: Percentage of budget consumed (actualHours / budgetHours * 100). Null when budgetHours is null.
consumptionPercentage.x-autobe-specification: Computed as (actualHours / budgetHours) * 100 when budgetHours is not null. Returns null when budgetHours is null (no budget constraint defined). Represents the percentage of budget consumed.

remainingHours.description: Remaining budget hours (budgetHours - actualHours). Null when budgetHours is null.
remainingHours.x-autobe-specification: Computed as budgetHours - actualHours when budgetHours is not null. Returns null when budgetHours is null (no budget constraint defined). Represents the remaining budget hours available.

IHrmPlatformProjectBudgetAnalytic.description: Project budget utilization analytics providing real-time tracking of budget consumption. This type compares the project's allocated budget hours against actual hours logged by employees through timelogs. Includes the project identifier, budget hours defined on the project, total hours recorded in timelogs, the percentage of budget consumed, and remaining budget hours. When no budget constraint is defined (budgetHours is null), the consumption percentage and remaining hours fields return null.
IHrmPlatformProjectBudgetAnalytic.x-autobe-specification: Computed analytics type combining data from hrm_platform_projects and hrm_platform_timelogs. Query hrm_platform_projects.budget_hours for the budgetHours value. Aggregate hrm_platform_timelogs by filtering where project_id matches the path parameter, sum duration_minutes field, divide by 60 to convert to hours for actualHours. Calculate consumptionPercentage as (actualHours / budgetHours) * 100 when budgetHours is not null, otherwise null. Calculate remainingHours as budgetHours - actualHours when budgetHours is not null, otherwise null. Exclude soft-deleted timelogs (deleted_at != null) from aggregation. Validate organization context and report:view permission before returning data.

rejection_reason.description: Reason for rejecting the timesheet. Must provide clear feedback to the employee about what corrections are needed before resubmission.
rejection_reason.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping to hrm_platform_timesheets.rejection_reason column. Nullable string with minLength 1 when provided. Service layer validates non-empty on reject operation. Service layer sets this value along with status='rejected', reviewed_at=now(), and reviewed_by_id from JWT.

IHrmPlatformTimesheet.IReject.description: Request body for rejecting a submitted timesheet. Contains the mandatory rejection reason that explains why the timesheet was rejected and what corrections the employee needs to make before resubmission.
IHrmPlatformTimesheet.IReject.x-autobe-specification: Request body for PATCH /hrmPlatform/member/timesheets/{timesheetId}/reject. Maps rejection_reason to hrm_platform_timesheets.rejection_reason. System-managed fields (status='rejected', reviewed_at=now(), reviewed_by_id from JWT) are set by the service layer, not from request body. Validation: rejection_reason required with minLength 1.

id.description: Unique identifier for the timer session.
id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_timers.id. UUID format.

started_at.description: Timestamp when the timer session was started.
started_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_timers.started_at. ISO 8601 date-time format with timezone.

stopped_at.description: Timestamp when the timer was stopped. Null if the timer is still running.
stopped_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_timers.stopped_at. Nullable - null indicates timer is currently running. ISO 8601 date-time format with timezone.

description.description: Optional description of the work being tracked.
description.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_timers.description. Nullable field for optional work description. Can be edited while timer is running.

project.description: The project being tracked by this timer session.
project.x-autobe-specification: Relation join from hrm_platform_timers.project_id to hrm_platform_projects.id. Returns IHrmPlatformProject.ISummary with essential project fields.

task.description: Optional task being tracked within the project. Null if timer is tracking project time without a specific task.
task.x-autobe-specification: Optional relation join from hrm_platform_timers.task_id to hrm_platform_tasks.id. Returns IHrmPlatformTask.ISummary or null if no task assigned. LEFT JOIN pattern.

IHrmPlatformTimer.ISummary.description: Lightweight timer session summary for list displays. Shows timer identification, start time, stop status (null indicates currently running), work description, and associated project with optional task reference. Used in paginated timer lists where employees view their current and historical timer sessions.
IHrmPlatformTimer.ISummary.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_timers with project and task relation joins. Query filters deleted_at IS NULL. Employee context resolved from JWT session, not included in response. FK columns employee_id, project_id, task_id are transformed to relation objects.

totalActiveEmployees.description: Total count of employees with active status in the organization
totalActiveEmployees.x-autobe-specification: COUNT from hrm_platform_employees WHERE status='active' AND organization_id=session.org_id AND deleted_at IS NULL. Returns integer representing total number of employees with active employment status in the current organization.

totalHoursThisWeek.description: Total hours logged by all employees in the current week (Monday-Sunday)
totalHoursThisWeek.x-autobe-specification: SUM(hrm_platform_timelogs.duration_minutes)/60 from hrm_platform_timelogs JOIN hrm_platform_employees ON timelogs.employee_id=employees.id WHERE employees.organization_id=session.org_id AND timelogs.date BETWEEN week_start AND week_end (defaults to current week Monday-Sunday based on organization timezone) AND timelogs.deleted_at IS NULL. Returns number representing total hours logged by all employees in the reporting period.

pendingTimesheetsCount.description: Number of timesheets with submitted status awaiting approval
pendingTimesheetsCount.x-autobe-specification: COUNT from hrm_platform_timesheets WHERE status='submitted' AND organization_id=session.org_id AND deleted_at IS NULL. Returns integer representing number of timesheets awaiting approval review.

projectsOverBudget.description: List of projects with budget utilization exceeding 80 percent
projectsOverBudget.x-autobe-specification: SELECT from hrm_platform_projects WHERE organization_id=session.org_id AND deleted_at IS NULL AND budget_hours IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT SUM(duration_minutes)/60 FROM hrm_platform_timelogs WHERE project_id=projects.id AND deleted_at IS NULL) / budget_hours * 100 > 80. Each project returned as IHrmPlatformProjectBudgetAnalytic with projectId, budgetHours, actualHours, consumptionPercentage, and remainingHours. Returns array of projects exceeding 80% budget utilization threshold.

topEmployeesByHours.description: Top 5 employees ranked by hours logged in the current week
topEmployeesByHours.x-autobe-specification: SELECT TOP 5 employees.id, employees.name, SUM(hrm_platform_timelogs.duration_minutes)/60 as total_hours from hrm_platform_employees JOIN hrm_platform_timelogs ON employees.id=timelogs.employee_id WHERE employees.organization_id=session.org_id AND timelogs.date BETWEEN week_start AND week_end (defaults to current week) AND employees.deleted_at IS NULL AND timelogs.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY employees.id ORDER BY total_hours DESC. Each employee returned as IHrmPlatformOrganizationDashboard.ITopEmployee with employeeId, name, and totalHours. Returns array of top 5 employees ranked by hours logged in the reporting period.

IHrmPlatformOrganizationDashboard.description: Organization dashboard statistics providing a comprehensive overview of organizational performance for members with report:view permission. Includes workforce metrics (total active employees), time tracking statistics (total hours logged this week, top 5 employees by hours), approval workflow status (pending timesheets awaiting review), and project health indicators (projects exceeding 80% budget utilization). All data is computed in real-time from multiple tables and strictly scoped to the current organization context.
IHrmPlatformOrganizationDashboard.x-autobe-specification: Aggregated dashboard response computed from multiple tables: 1) totalActiveEmployees: COUNT from hrm_platform_employees WHERE status='active' AND organization_id=session.org_id AND deleted_at IS NULL. 2) totalHoursThisWeek: SUM(timelogs.duration_minutes)/60 from hrm_platform_timelogs JOIN hrm_platform_employees ON timelogs.employee_id=employees.id WHERE employees.organization_id=session.org_id AND timelogs.date BETWEEN week_start AND week_end (defaults to current week Monday-Sunday based on organization timezone) AND timelogs.deleted_at IS NULL. 3) pendingTimesheetsCount: COUNT from hrm_platform_timesheets WHERE status='submitted' AND organization_id=session.org_id AND deleted_at IS NULL. 4) projectsOverBudget: SELECT projects from hrm_platform_projects WHERE organization_id=session.org_id AND deleted_at IS NULL AND budget_hours IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT SUM(duration_minutes)/60 FROM hrm_platform_timelogs WHERE project_id=projects.id AND deleted_at IS NULL) / budget_hours * 100 > 80, returned as IHrmPlatformProjectBudgetAnalytic array. 5) topEmployeesByHours: SELECT TOP 5 employees with SUM(timelogs.duration_minutes)/60 as total_hours from hrm_platform_employees JOIN hrm_platform_timelogs ON employees.id=timelogs.employee_id WHERE employees.organization_id=session.org_id AND timelogs.date BETWEEN week_start AND week_end AND employees.deleted_at IS NULL AND timelogs.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY employees.id ORDER BY total_hours DESC, returned as IHrmPlatformOrganizationDashboard.ITopEmployee array. All queries strictly scoped to organization_id from session context for multi-tenant data isolation. Requires report:view permission.

weekStart.description: Start date of the week period (Monday 00:00 in organization timezone)
weekStart.x-autobe-specification: Computed from timelogs: MIN(date) truncated to Monday 00:00 in organization timezone.

weekEnd.description: End date of the week period (Sunday 23:59 in organization timezone)
weekEnd.x-autobe-specification: Computed from timelogs: MAX(date) truncated to Sunday 23:59 in organization timezone.

totalHours.description: Total hours worked during the week (sum of all timelog durations converted from minutes)
totalHours.x-autobe-specification: Computed from timelogs: SUM(duration_minutes) / 60 to convert minutes to hours.

timelogCount.description: Total number of individual timelog entries recorded during the week
timelogCount.x-autobe-specification: Computed from timelogs: COUNT(*) of all timelog entries in the week period.

employeeCount.description: Number of unique employees who logged time during the week
employeeCount.x-autobe-specification: Computed from timelogs: COUNT(DISTINCT employee_id) of unique employees who logged time.

IHrmPlatformWeeklySummaryReport.ISummary.description: Weekly summary statistics for time tracking reports containing aggregated metrics for a specific week period: total hours worked, number of timelog entries, and count of unique employees who logged time.
IHrmPlatformWeeklySummaryReport.ISummary.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation from hrm_platform_timelogs: group by week period (Monday-Sunday based on organization timezone). weekStart: MIN(date) truncated to Monday 00:00. weekEnd: MAX(date) truncated to Sunday 23:59. totalHours: SUM(duration_minutes) / 60. timelogCount: COUNT(*) of timelog entries. employeeCount: COUNT(DISTINCT employee_id). Filter by organization_id via JOIN with hrm_platform_employees. Optional project filter via JOIN with hrm_platform_projects.

totalProjects.description: Total number of projects in the organization across all statuses (active, archived, and completed).
totalProjects.x-autobe-specification: Aggregate COUNT(*) from hrm_platform_projects filtered by organization_id from session context. Include all projects regardless of status. Exclude soft-deleted projects if deleted_at is set.

statusBreakdown.description: Project counts grouped by status, showing the number of active, archived, and completed projects in the organization.
statusBreakdown.x-autobe-specification: Aggregate from hrm_platform_projects filtered by organization_id. GROUP BY status field and COUNT projects in each status category (active, archived, completed). Return as object with three required integer properties. Exclude soft-deleted projects.

budgetUtilization.description: Array of projects with budget utilization exceeding 80%. Each entry includes the project's budget hours, actual hours logged this week, consumption percentage, and remaining budget hours. Used to identify projects approaching or exceeding their allocated budget.
budgetUtilization.x-autobe-specification: Filter hrm_platform_projects where budget_hours IS NOT NULL and organization_id matches session. JOIN with hrm_platform_timelogs (exclude soft-deleted) where timelog.date >= start of current week (Monday 00:00 KST). SUM duration_minutes per project, divide by 60 for actual_hours. Calculate consumptionPercentage = (actual_hours / budget_hours) * 100. Filter WHERE consumptionPercentage > 80. Return as array of IHrmPlatformProjectBudgetAnalytic with projectId, budgetHours, actualHours, consumptionPercentage, and remainingHours.

topProjectsByHours.description: Top 5 projects ranked by total hours logged by employees in the current week. Each entry includes the project identifier, name, and total hours logged. Used to identify the most active projects in the organization.
topProjectsByHours.x-autobe-specification: JOIN hrm_platform_projects with hrm_platform_timelogs (exclude soft-deleted) where timelog.date >= start of current week (Monday 00:00 KST) and organization_id matches session. GROUP BY project_id, SUM duration_minutes. ORDER BY sum DESC. LIMIT 5. Return as array of IHrmPlatformProjectDashboard.ITopProject containing projectId, projectName, and totalHoursLogged. Projects with no timelogs this week are excluded.

IHrmPlatformProjectDashboard.description: Project dashboard statistics for organization overview. Provides aggregated metrics including total project counts broken down by status (active, archived, completed), budget utilization alerts for projects consuming over 80% of allocated hours, and top performing projects ranked by hours logged in the current week. Used for organizational health monitoring and resource allocation decisions. All data is scoped to the authenticated user's current organization context and requires report:view permission.
IHrmPlatformProjectDashboard.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation type combining data from hrm_platform_projects and hrm_platform_timelogs. Filter projects by organization_id from session context. totalProjects: COUNT all projects. statusBreakdown: GROUP BY status field (active, archived, completed) and COUNT each. budgetUtilization: Filter projects where budget_hours IS NOT NULL, JOIN with hrm_platform_timelogs (exclude soft-deleted) where timelog.date >= start of current week, SUM duration_minutes / 60 for actual_hours, calculate utilization = (actual_hours / budget_hours) * 100, filter WHERE utilization > 80, return as IHrmPlatformProjectBudgetAnalytic array. topProjectsByHours: JOIN projects with timelogs where timelog.date >= start of current week, GROUP BY project_id, SUM duration_minutes, ORDER BY sum DESC, LIMIT 5, return as IHrmPlatformProjectDashboard.ITopProject array. All queries scoped to authenticated user's current organization_id.

groupType.description: The dimension used for grouping time entries: employee, project, task, or date.
groupType.x-autobe-specification: Derived from the groupBy request parameter. Value is one of: 'employee', 'project', 'task', or 'date'. Determines which dimension was used to group timelog records and which entity type appears in groupValue.

groupValue.description: The grouped entity's summary information (employee, project, or task) or date value, depending on the groupType.
groupValue.x-autobe-specification: Returns IHrmPlatformEmployee.ISummary when groupType is 'employee', IHrmPlatformProject.ISummary when 'project', IHrmPlatformTask.ISummary when 'task', or IHrmPlatformTimeReport.IDateGroup when 'date'. Populated via JOIN to the respective entity tables based on the grouping dimension.

totalHours.description: Total hours logged in this group, calculated as the sum of all timelog durations converted from minutes to hours.
totalHours.x-autobe-specification: Calculated as SUM(duration_minutes) / 60.0 from all timelog records in the group. Converts minutes to hours for reporting. Aggregated from hrm_platform_timelogs.duration_minutes field.

billableHours.description: Total billable hours in this group, including only timelogs marked as billable.
billableHours.x-autobe-specification: Calculated as SUM(CASE WHEN billable THEN duration_minutes ELSE 0 END) / 60.0 from hrm_platform_timelogs. Only includes timelogs where the billable flag is true. Converted from minutes to hours.

nonBillableHours.description: Total non-billable hours in this group, including only timelogs not marked as billable.
nonBillableHours.x-autobe-specification: Calculated as SUM(CASE WHEN NOT billable THEN duration_minutes ELSE 0 END) / 60.0 from hrm_platform_timelogs. Only includes timelogs where the billable flag is false. Converted from minutes to hours.

entryCount.description: Number of individual timelog entries included in this group's aggregation.
entryCount.x-autobe-specification: Calculated as COUNT(*) of hrm_platform_timelogs records in the group. Represents the number of individual time entries that were aggregated into this result.

IHrmPlatformTimeReport.description: Aggregated time report statistics representing grouped time tracking data. Each record contains a grouping dimension (employee, project, task, or date), the grouped entity's summary information, total hours logged, breakdown of billable vs non-billable hours, and the count of time entries. Used for organizational reporting, budget analysis, and productivity tracking.
IHrmPlatformTimeReport.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation from hrm_platform_timelogs table. Query groups timelogs by requested dimension (employee_id, project_id, task_id, or DATE). For each group: totalHours = SUM(duration_minutes) / 60.0, billableHours = SUM(CASE WHEN billable THEN duration_minutes ELSE 0 END) / 60.0, nonBillableHours = SUM(CASE WHEN NOT billable THEN duration_minutes ELSE 0 END) / 60.0, entryCount = COUNT(*). JOIN hrm_platform_employees, hrm_platform_projects, hrm_platform_tasks for entity summaries in groupValue. Filter by organization_id through employee record for data isolation. groupType reflects the groupBy request parameter value.

employeeId.x-autobe-specification: Maps to hrm_platform_employees.id from JOIN result. Selected and grouped by employee in the aggregation query.

name.x-autobe-specification: Maps to hrm_platform_employees.display_name from JOIN result. Selected from the employee record in the aggregation query.

totalHours.description: Total hours logged by this employee in the reporting period.
totalHours.x-autobe-specification: Computed as SUM(hrm_platform_timelogs.duration_minutes)/60 from all timelogs in the reporting period. Aggregated via GROUP BY employee_id.

IHrmPlatformOrganizationDashboard.ITopEm.description: Individual employee entry in the top performers ranking for organization dashboard. Shows the employee's identifier, display name, and total hours logged during the reporting period. Used to highlight the 5 employees with highest time contribution.
IHrmPlatformOrganizationDashboard.ITopEm.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation from hrm_platform_employees JOIN hrm_platform_timelogs ON employees.id=timelogs.employee_id. Query: SELECT employees.id as employeeId, employees.name, SUM(timelogs.duration_minutes)/60 as totalHours WHERE employees.organization_id=session.org_id AND timelogs.date BETWEEN week_start AND week_end AND employees.deleted_at IS NULL AND timelogs.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY employees.id ORDER BY totalHours DESC LIMIT 5. Returns top 5 employees ranked by hours logged in the reporting period.

IEHrmPlatformProjectStatus.description: Project lifecycle status enumeration. Active projects can receive timelogs and are currently in progress. Archived projects are preserved for historical reference but cannot receive new timelogs. Completed projects are finished and cannot receive new timelogs.
IEHrmPlatformProjectStatus.x-autobe-specification: Enum type with three string literal values: active, archived, completed. Maps to hrm_platform_projects.status column. Used in project-related response DTOs to indicate project lifecycle state.

id.description: Unique session identifier.
id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_guest_sessions.id. UUID primary key.

guest_id.description: Reference to the guest account that owns this session.
guest_id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_guest_sessions.guest_id. Foreign key reference to hrm_platform_guests.id.

ip.description: IP address of the client connection when session was created.
ip.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_guest_sessions.ip. Client IP address captured at session creation.

href.description: Full URL of the page where the guest joined the platform.
href.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_guest_sessions.href. Full URL of the page where the guest joined the platform.

referrer.description: Referrer URL from which the guest arrived at the platform.
referrer.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_guest_sessions.referrer. Referrer URL from which the guest arrived at the platform.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the session was created.
created_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_guest_sessions.created_at. Session creation timestamp.

expired_at.description: Timestamp when the session expires and becomes invalid.
expired_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_guest_sessions.expired_at. Session expiration timestamp after which the session is invalid.

IHrmPlatformGuestSession.description: Guest authentication session record containing connection metadata and expiration information. This DTO represents a single authentication session for a guest visitor, tracking connection details including IP address, current page URL (href), and referrer URL for audit purposes. The session has a defined lifetime controlled by the expired_at timestamp. Sessions are created when guests join the platform via device fingerprint authentication and are used to maintain temporary access state.
IHrmPlatformGuestSession.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_guest_sessions table columns: id, guest_id, ip, href, referrer, created_at, expired_at. This is a session metadata DTO - the guest relation is not exposed here; guest details are fetched separately via guest endpoints. JWT tokens (access_token, refresh_token) are NOT included in this schema for security; they are only returned in IHrmPlatformGuest.IAuthorized during join/refresh operations.

date.description: The date for this time aggregation in YYYY-MM-DD format, representing a single calendar day's logged time.
date.x-autobe-specification: Computed from DATE(date) aggregation of hrm_platform_timelogs.date. Groups timelogs by calendar date using SQL DATE() function. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

totalMinutes.description: Total minutes logged on this date across all timelogs in the project, providing precise time measurement in minute granularity.
totalMinutes.x-autobe-specification: Computed from SUM(duration_minutes) aggregation of hrm_platform_timelogs.duration_minutes. Sums all timelog durations for the given date within the project filter context. Integer value representing total minutes.

totalHours.description: Total hours logged on this date, calculated by dividing total minutes by 60. Provides decimal precision for time representation in hour units.
totalHours.x-autobe-specification: Computed from totalMinutes / 60.0 division. Derived field that converts total minutes to decimal hours for easier time interpretation. Number type with decimal precision.

IHrmPlatformProjectTimeAnalytic.IDailyBr.description: Daily time breakdown entry showing aggregated time logged on a specific date within a project. Contains the date and total time spent in both minutes and hours for granular time tracking analytics and productivity visualization.
IHrmPlatformProjectTimeAnalytic.IDailyBr.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation from hrm_platform_timelogs grouped by DATE(date). Query: SELECT DATE(date) as date, SUM(duration_minutes) as totalMinutes, SUM(duration_minutes)/60.0 as totalHours FROM hrm_platform_timelogs WHERE project_id = ? GROUP BY DATE(date) ORDER BY date ASC. Each row represents one day's aggregated time within the filtered project context. Returns empty array if no timelogs match filters.

IHrmPlatformProjectTimeAnalytic.IGroupBy.description: Enumeration of available grouping dimensions for project time analytics. Controls how time tracking data is aggregated and organized in the response. Grouping by employee shows time contribution per team member. Grouping by task shows time distribution across work items. Grouping by date shows daily logging patterns. Grouping by week shows weekly aggregation.
IHrmPlatformProjectTimeAnalytic.IGroupBy.x-autobe-specification: String enum type for grouping dimension in time analytics queries. Values map to SQL GROUP BY clauses: 'employee' → GROUP BY employee_id with JOIN to hrm_platform_employees, 'task' → GROUP BY task_id with JOIN to hrm_platform_tasks, 'date' → GROUP BY DATE(date), 'week' → GROUP BY YEAR(date), WEEK(date). Determines which breakdown array is populated in the response (employeeBreakdown, taskBreakdown, dailyBreakdown).

fromDate.description: The earliest date among all timelogs in the filtered result set. Null when no timelogs match the applied filters.
fromDate.x-autobe-specification: Computed as MIN(date) from hrm_platform_timelogs table, filtered by project_id and request body filters (date range, employeeIds, taskIds, billable). Returns ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD) or null when no timelogs match.

toDate.description: The latest date among all timelogs in the filtered result set. Null when no timelogs match the applied filters.
toDate.x-autobe-specification: Computed as MAX(date) from hrm_platform_timelogs table, filtered by project_id and request body filters (date range, employeeIds, taskIds, billable). Returns ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD) or null when no timelogs match.

IHrmPlatformProjectTimeAnalytic.IDateRan.description: Date range boundaries for project time analytics, representing the earliest and latest timelog dates in the filtered result set. Used to display the time span covered by the analytics data. Both fromDate and toDate are null when no timelogs match the applied filters, indicating an empty dataset.
IHrmPlatformProjectTimeAnalytic.IDateRan.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation from hrm_platform_timelogs table. fromDate = MIN(date), toDate = MAX(date) across all timelogs matching the filter criteria (project_id, date range, employeeIds, taskIds, billable). Returns ISO date strings (YYYY-MM-DD) or null when no timelogs match. Query: SELECT MIN(date) as fromDate, MAX(date) as toDate FROM hrm_platform_timelogs WHERE project_id = ? AND filter conditions. Both properties are null together when result set is empty.

date.description: The grouped date in ISO 8601 date format (YYYY-MM-DD). Represents the date dimension when time entries are aggregated by date.
date.x-autobe-specification: Derived from DATE(timelog.date) SQL function when groupBy is 'date'. Returns ISO 8601 date format (YYYY-MM-DD). No direct column mapping - computed aggregation field from timelogs table.

IHrmPlatformTimeReport.IDateGroup.description: Date grouping dimension for time tracking reports. Represents a specific date period when time entries are aggregated by date instead of by entity (employee, project, or task). Used in time report responses when the groupBy parameter is set to 'date', allowing users to analyze time allocation patterns over time periods.
IHrmPlatformTimeReport.IDateGroup.x-autobe-specification: Computed type for date-based time report grouping. Contains single 'date' field derived from DATE(timelog.date) SQL function. When IHrmPlatformTimeReport.IRequest.groupBy is 'date', SQL GROUP BY DATE(timelog.date) is applied and each result row's groupValue contains IDateGroup with the grouped date. Date is in ISO 8601 date format (YYYY-MM-DD) without time component. No database table mapping - purely computed aggregation dimension.

projectId.description: Unique identifier of the project in UUID format.
projectId.x-autobe-specification: Sourced from hrm_platform_projects.id (UUID). Retrieved via JOIN with hrm_platform_timelogs grouped by project_id. Part of computed aggregation query.

projectName.x-autobe-specification: Sourced from hrm_platform_projects.name. Retrieved via JOIN with hrm_platform_timelogs grouped by project_id. Part of computed aggregation query.

totalHoursLogged.description: Total hours logged by all employees on this project during the current week.
totalHoursLogged.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation: SUM(hrm_platform_timelogs.duration_minutes) / 60.0 for timelogs where date >= current week start (Monday 00:00 KST). Excludes soft-deleted timelogs (deleted_at IS NOT NULL). Result is total hours as a number with minimum value 0.

IHrmPlatformProjectDashboard.ITopProject.description: Top project summary for organization dashboard showing projects ranked by total hours logged in the current week. Each entry includes the project's unique identifier, display name, and aggregated hours from all employee timelogs. Used to identify the most active projects. Data is scoped to the authenticated user's current organization and limited to the top 5 projects.
IHrmPlatformProjectDashboard.ITopProject.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation DTO joining hrm_platform_projects and hrm_platform_timelogs. Query: SELECT p.id, p.name, SUM(tl.duration_minutes) / 60.0 AS totalHoursLogged FROM hrm_platform_projects p INNER JOIN hrm_platform_timelogs tl ON p.id = tl.project_id WHERE tl.date >= start of current week (Monday 00:00 KST) AND p.organization_id = session.organization_id AND tl.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY totalHoursLogged DESC LIMIT 5. Returns top 5 projects by hours logged in current week. Projects with no timelogs this week are excluded.

task_id.x-autobe-specification: Derived from timelogs.task_id via GROUP BY aggregation. Null when timelog has no task association. Joined with tasks table for title lookup.
task_id.description: Unique identifier of the task. Null for timelogs not associated with any specific task.

title.description: Task title from hrm_platform_tasks. Shows 'Unassigned' for timelogs without task association.
title.x-autobe-specification: Retrieved from tasks.title via JOIN on timelogs.task_id = tasks.id. Shows 'Unassigned' when task_id is null.

totalMinutes.description: Total minutes logged to this task. Sum of duration_minutes from all matching timelogs.
totalMinutes.x-autobe-specification: Aggregated sum of timelogs.duration_minutes grouped by task_id. Computed from filtered timelog records matching project_id and request body filters.

totalHours.description: Total hours logged to this task, calculated as totalMinutes divided by 60. Provides human-readable time representation.
totalHours.x-autobe-specification: Calculated as totalMinutes / 60.0. Derived value providing human-readable time representation.

IHrmPlatformProjectTimeAnalytic.ITaskBre.description: Task-level time breakdown entry showing aggregated time spent on a specific task within a project. Each entry represents one task (or unassigned time) with its identifier, title, and total time logged. Used in project time analytics to visualize effort distribution across tasks. Derived from grouping timelog records by task and joining with task metadata.
IHrmPlatformProjectTimeAnalytic.ITaskBre.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation DTO for project time analytics. Generated by GROUP BY task_id on hrm_platform_timelogs filtered by project_id and request body filters. JOIN hrm_platform_tasks on task_id to retrieve title. Properties: task_id from timelogs.task_id (null when no task), title from tasks.title ('Unassigned' when null task_id), totalMinutes as SUM(duration_minutes), totalHours as totalMinutes/60.0. Returns empty array if no timelogs match filters.

employee_id.description: Unique identifier of the employee who logged time.
employee_id.x-autobe-specification: Sourced from hrm_platform_timelogs.employee_id. Groups timelogs by employee for aggregation within project context.

name.description: Employee's display name for UI presentation.
name.x-autobe-specification: Joined from hrm_platform_employees.display_name via employee_id foreign key. Part of computed result set.

avatar_url.description: Employee's avatar image URL. Null if no avatar uploaded.
avatar_url.x-autobe-specification: Joined from hrm_platform_employees.avatar_url. Nullable - null if no avatar uploaded. Part of computed result set.

totalMinutes.description: Total minutes logged by this employee in the project.
totalMinutes.x-autobe-specification: Computed as SUM(duration_minutes) from hrm_platform_timelogs grouped by employee_id. Aggregation query result.

totalHours.description: Total hours logged by this employee, calculated as totalMinutes / 60.0.
totalHours.x-autobe-specification: Computed as totalMinutes / 60.0. Derived from totalMinutes aggregation.

IHrmPlatformProjectTimeAnalytic.IEmploye.description: Employee-level time breakdown showing an individual team member's contribution to project time tracking. Contains employee identification (ID, name, avatar) and aggregated time metrics (total minutes and hours logged). Used in project analytics to visualize time distribution across team members.
IHrmPlatformProjectTimeAnalytic.IEmploye.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation from hrm_platform_timelogs joined with hrm_platform_employees. Query: SELECT t.employee_id, e.name, e.avatar_url, SUM(t.duration_minutes) as totalMinutes, SUM(t.duration_minutes)/60.0 as totalHours FROM hrm_platform_timelogs t JOIN hrm_platform_employees e ON t.employee_id = e.id WHERE t.project_id = {projectId} GROUP BY t.employee_id. Returns employee identification and aggregated time metrics for project analytics.

billableMinutes.description: Total minutes logged as billable time. Sum of duration_minutes from all timelogs where the billable flag is true.
billableMinutes.x-autobe-specification: Computed as SUM(duration_minutes) from hrm_platform_timelogs where billable = true, filtered by project_id and request body filters. Returns 0 if no matching timelogs.

nonBillableMinutes.description: Total minutes logged as non-billable time. Sum of duration_minutes from all timelogs where the billable flag is false.
nonBillableMinutes.x-autobe-specification: Computed as SUM(duration_minutes) from hrm_platform_timelogs where billable = false, filtered by project_id and request body filters. Returns 0 if no matching timelogs.

billableHours.description: Total hours logged as billable time. Computed by dividing billableMinutes by 60.0.
billableHours.x-autobe-specification: Computed by dividing billableMinutes by 60.0. Derived value, not stored in database.

nonBillableHours.description: Total hours logged as non-billable time. Computed by dividing nonBillableMinutes by 60.0.
nonBillableHours.x-autobe-specification: Computed by dividing nonBillableMinutes by 60.0. Derived value, not stored in database.

IHrmPlatformProjectTimeAnalytic.IBillabl.description: Billable versus non-billable time breakdown for project time analytics. Shows the distribution of chargeable work time (billable) versus non-chargeable work time (non-billable) in both minutes and hours. Used for project billing analysis, client invoicing, and internal cost tracking. Values default to zero when no timelogs match the filter criteria.
IHrmPlatformProjectTimeAnalytic.IBillabl.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation from hrm_platform_timelogs filtered by project_id and request filters. billableMinutes = SUM(duration_minutes) WHERE billable = true. nonBillableMinutes = SUM(duration_minutes) WHERE billable = false. billableHours = billableMinutes / 60.0. nonBillableHours = nonBillableMinutes / 60.0. All values default to 0 if no matching timelogs exist. No direct table mapping - this is a computed DTO for analytics response.

id.description: Unique identifier for the member account.
id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_members.id. UUID primary key generated on account creation.

email.description: Member's email address used for login and notifications.
email.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_members.email. Unique constraint enforced. Used for login and account communication.

display_name.description: Member's display name shown across all organizations and in the global profile.
display_name.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_members.display_name. Global profile field shared across all organizations.

avatar_url.description: Profile avatar image URL, null if not set.
avatar_url.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_members.avatar_url. Nullable string (VARCHAR(80000)). Null when no avatar set.

phone_number.description: Contact phone number, null if not provided.
phone_number.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_members.phone_number. Nullable string. Optional field for account recovery or communication.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the member account was created.
created_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_members.created_at. Timestamptz format. Set on account creation, immutable.

IHrmPlatformMember.ISummary.description: Lightweight member profile summary for display in lists and nested relations. Contains essential identification and global profile information consistent across all organizations. Used in employee records, organization ownership, session metadata, activity logs, task history, and timesheet review contexts.
IHrmPlatformMember.ISummary.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_members table for summary display. Query by member ID via JOIN from referencing entities. Filter deleted_at IS NULL for active members only. Excluded: password_hash (security), updated_at/deleted_at (system fields), all has-many relations (separate endpoints).
